t: You are on Bishopsgate, a street in the City of London that forms part of the A10. Several people connected to it are recorded. The librarian James Laver Ohlson, who was involved with the West India Committee, and Emily Josephine Fox were both born here. Herbert Cecil Benyon Berens, an accountant, banker, wartime officer and cricketer, lived here. Thomas Davenant Lamplugh, Archdeacon of Richmond, died on this street. So as you walk, you are following a road with a long line of ordinary and notable Londoners behind it.
